# `agents-md` command

Generate the build, test and verification instructions for coding agents (`AGENTS.md`) from the fobos and the
sources, between `<!-- fobis:begin agents-md -->` and `<!-- fobis:end agents-md -->`: the rest of the file is
kept.

```bash
fobis agents-md [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Models, knowledge and agents](/cookbook/ai-setup).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--output`, `-o` | TEXT |  | File to update (repeatable, e.g. CLAUDE.md) [default: AGENTS.md]. |
| `--check` |  |  | Write nothing; exit 1 when a file's generated block is stale or missing. |
| `--print` |  |  | Print the generated block; write nothing. |
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Specify a "fobos" file named differently from "fobos" |
| `--fci` |  |  | Assume fobos inputs as case insensitive |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | Select a mode defined into a fobos file |
| `--json` |  |  | Emit structured JSON to stdout instead of human-readable output (useful for scripting / agents) |

<!-- cli:end -->
